annotations.title: Share an HTML page for feedback

description: Publish a complete HTML page (for example a landing page, prototype or one-pager you just wrote) to HTMLAnnotate and get a review link. Anyone with the link can open the page and click any heading, button or image to leave a comment pinned to it, with no account. Pass the whole page as one self-contained HTML document (inline the CSS; images as URLs or data URIs). Returns the review link to send to the client and a private manage link for the owner.

html.description: The full HTML document, starting with <!doctype html> or <html>.

notify_email.description: Optional. The user's email, so HTMLAnnotate emails them when someone comments. Ask the user before sharing whether they want this.

title.description: Optional short name for the page, used in the file name.

name: share_html
title: Share an HTML page for feedback
